name: B10-0427/2025 (ECR) – Situation in Afghanistan: supporting women and communities affected by the recent earthquakes
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Afghanistan: supporting women and communities affected by the recent earthquakes
part_text:
The European Parliament expresses sympathy for Afghans hit by recent earthquakes and condemns the Taliban's restrictions on women and girls. It calls for women to be allowed to take part in aid work and reconstruction, and for the Taliban to lift all restrictions blocking them from delivering aid. It asks the European Union and its member states to make sure aid reaches the most needy, especially women, children and vulnerable communities, and to tie support to guarantees that women aid workers can do their jobs.

- The EU is asked to keep sending aid but only with guarantees for women aid workers.
- Women, children and vulnerable communities in earthquake-hit areas are affected.
- The Parliament asks the EU and member states to act; it cannot change laws itself.
